prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic high-angle bathroom portrait of an approved adult relaxing in a bubble bath.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark brown hair in a compact messy bun and natural skin texture, wearing a brown-and-black snakeskin one-piece swimsuit with secure coverage, seated comfortably in opaque white foam.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle rear three-quarter snapshot with face visible in a large horizontal mirror, one forearm resting on the tub rim, knees submerged in bubbles, candles, rolled towels, toiletries, plant, basket, and bathroom shelving.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Moody bathroom lighting with warm candle accents, dark metallic subway tiles, soft reflections on foam and porcelain, calm self-reflective atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone snapshot, high-angle wide lens, realistic skin and foam texture, natural proportions, deep focus, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with dark brown hair in a compact messy bun sits comfortably in a white bathtub filled with opaque foam, looking back over her shoulder toward the camera. She wears a brown-and-black snakeskin one-piece swimsuit with secure coverage. The composition is a high-angle rear three-quarter snapshot with her face visible in a large horizontal mirror; one forearm rests on the tub rim and her knees remain submerged in bubbles. Dark metallic or grey subway tiles, candles, rolled white towels, toiletries, a plant, basket, and bathroom shelving fill the scene. Use moody warm bathroom lighting, realistic foam and skin texture, natural proportions, and a photorealistic smartphone wide-angle look.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, bikini, thong, cheeky bottoms, exposed buttocks, body-part emphasis, pronounced lordosis, sexualized pose, nudity, transparent foam, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
